verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's spec page lists real numbers for three of the four items: the 18-core layout with 5.0 GHz boost on Extreme, 85 TOPS for the NPU, and 228 GB/s LPDDR5x bandwidth. It publishes no TDP or power figure (left to OEMs), no maximum memory capacity, and no precision or test conditions for the TOPS figure. Community comments independently point to the missing TDP data and the lack of benchmarks. The page also serves only a JavaScript shell to non-browser fetchers. Missing for 10: TDP/power envelope, max memory capacity, TOPS precision/test conditions, process node, benchmark methodology, a spec page readable without JavaScript.
